_comment: Audience-tailored cuts derived from index.html (the single source of truth). Each variant keeps sections whose data-audience contains 'all' or the variant's audience token, applies the head + hero overrides below, and is written to <outDir>/index.html. Add a new object here to add a cut — no new plumbing. See build.mjs.
